name: Paris no Sakura
source:
Maeda Sakura, a columnist living in Tokyo, has just been dumped by her girlfriend of two years, Megumi, who claims that Sakura has problems committing. Realising that Megumi might have a point, Sakura meditates on this and concludes that her father abandoning her and her mother when she was a young child may have led to Sakura’s problems committing. A few days later, she helps her mother move from her home to an apartment and discovers a box labelled “Jean-Luc Dupont”. Inside the box she finds a photo of Jean-Luc, Sakura, and her mother from a few years back. Realising that Jean-Luc is her father and seeing that the box has plenty of clues that indicate that Luc moved back to Paris, she goes on a trip of a lifetime to Paris to confront her father. Along the way, she meets some beautiful women in Paris and perhaps she might even fall in love with one of them.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2460000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
前田樱是一位住在东京的专栏作家。交往两年的女友惠刚刚与她分手，理由是樱无法认真投入一段感情。樱意识到惠的话或许有道理，反复思索后，她认为这可能与父亲有关：小时候，父亲抛弃了她和母亲。几天后，她帮母亲从原来的家搬到公寓，在整理时发现了一个写着“让-吕克·杜邦”的箱子。箱中有一张几年前让-吕克、樱与母亲的合照。樱意识到，让-吕克就是自己的父亲，而箱子里还有许多线索表明他搬回了巴黎。于是，她踏上了一场改变人生的巴黎之旅，决心当面质问父亲。旅途中，她会在巴黎结识几位美丽的女性，或许，还会爱上其中一人。

[编译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2460000/]Steam[/url]]
